name: wg_width
description: WG ridge width at the BASE (as drawn in GDS)

name: wg_radius
description: Minimum bend radius of the WG cross-section

name: sidewall_angle
description: Ridge sidewall angle measured from the slab surface

name: s_bend_length
description: Length of the sine S-bends along x

name: dc_port_separation
description: Centre-to-centre arm separation at the coupler ports

name: dc_gap
description: Directional coupler gap at the ridge base (50:50 design)

name: dc_length
description: Directional coupler straight coupled length (50:50 design)

name: taper_width_wide
description: Wide end of the grating-coupler taper (= grating width)

name: taper_length
description: Grating-coupler taper length (PLACEHOLDER until the EME sweep is done)

name: gc_period
description: Grating coupler period (3D FDTD: 0.384 peak eff at 1558 nm; 1550 nm eff 0.370)

name: gc_fill
description: Grating tooth BASE width divided by period

name: gc_fiber_angle
description: Fibre tilt in air; positive = tilted toward the waveguide side in the 3D FDTD convention
